# spinkit-react

> A quiet React kit for the pause between tap and result. Thirty-eight loading indicators, one calm API.

```sh
npm install spinkit-react
```

```tsx
import { Spin, SpinnerGroup } from "spinkit-react";

<SpinnerGroup>
  <Spin intent="button" />
  Saving…
</SpinnerGroup>
```

All indicators support `size`, `intent` (`button` | `inline` | `page`), `color`, `duration`,
`easing`, `thickness`, `cap`, `playState`, `label` and `motion`. `Track` and `Progress` also accept
optional `value` (0–1) for determinate progress. Some expose additional controls like `count`,
`arc`, `spokes` or `petals`. Use `SpinnerGroup` to lay out a spinner beside a label.

The spinners respect reduced motion out of the box and require React 19 or later.

## Spinners

- [Spin](/spinners/spin): An arc rotating around a faint track. Import as `Spin`.
- [Dots](/spinners/dots): Dots hopping one after another. Import as `Dots`.
- [Typing](/spinners/typing): Dots fading in and out, like someone typing. Import as `Typing`.
- [Bars](/spinners/bars): Bars bouncing like an equalizer. Import as `Bars`.
- [Beacon](/spinners/beacon): Rings radiating from a solid core. Import as `Beacon`.
- [Moons](/spinners/moons): Two moons circling a planet. Import as `Moons`.
- [Grid](/spinners/grid): Four tiles lighting up clockwise. Import as `Grid`.
- [Radial](/spinners/radial): Spokes with a highlight sweeping around. Import as `Radial`.
- [Loop](/spinners/loop): A dash travelling along a figure eight. Import as `Loop`.
- [Heartbeat](/spinners/heartbeat): A pulse crossing a heart-rate line. Import as `Heartbeat`.
- [Pendulum](/spinners/pendulum): A weight swinging from a pivot. Import as `Pendulum`.
- [Bloom](/spinners/bloom): Petals swelling and shrinking in turn. Import as `Bloom`.
- [Hourglass](/spinners/hourglass): An hourglass draining and flipping over. Import as `Hourglass`.
- [Honeycomb](/spinners/honeycomb): A ring of hexagons around a centre cell. Import as `Honeycomb`.
- [Signal](/spinners/signal): Waves lighting up from the source outward. Import as `Signal`.
- [Battery](/spinners/battery): A battery charging cell by cell. Import as `Battery`.
- [Track](/spinners/track): An indeterminate or determinate progress bar (`value` 0–1). Import as `Track`.
- [Gear](/spinners/gear): A turning gear. Import as `Gear`.
- [Sun](/spinners/sun): Rays turning around a glowing core. Import as `Sun`.
- [Radar](/spinners/radar): A sweep that lights up a blip as it passes. Import as `Radar`.
- [Ball](/spinners/ball): A ball bouncing and squashing on the floor. Import as `Ball`.
- [Lines](/spinners/lines): Placeholder lines filling in, like a skeleton. Import as `Lines`.
- [Chase](/spinners/chase): Two dots chasing around a square. Import as `Chase`.
- [Stretch](/spinners/stretch): An arc that grows and shrinks as it turns. Import as `Stretch`.
- [Twin](/spinners/twin): Two arcs turning in opposite directions. Import as `Twin`.
- [Tail](/spinners/tail): A ring with a fading tail, like a comet. Import as `Tail`.
- [Tumble](/spinners/tumble): A square flipping over on one axis, then the other. Import as `Tumble`.
- [Timer](/spinners/timer): A clock face with sweeping hands. Import as `Timer`.
- [Helix](/spinners/helix): Two strands of dots twisting like DNA. Import as `Helix`.
- [Sync](/spinners/sync): Two arrows cycling around each other. Import as `Sync`.
- [Cursor](/spinners/cursor): A line being typed with a blinking caret. Import as `Cursor`.
- [Progress](/spinners/progress): A ring filling up (`value` 0–1 for determinate). Import as `Progress`.
- [Spiral](/spinners/spiral): Dots spiralling in toward the centre. Import as `Spiral`.
- [Cloud](/spinners/cloud): A cloud with an arrow rising into it. Import as `Cloud`.
- [Spark](/spinners/spark): Soft sparks for AI thinking moments. Import as `Spark`.
- [Waveform](/spinners/waveform): A voice-style waveform for streaming audio. Import as `Waveform`.
- [Orbit](/spinners/orbit): Three agents orbiting a shared centre. Import as `Orbit`.
- [Shimmer](/spinners/shimmer): A soft shimmer for text or card placeholders. Import as `Shimmer`.
